notes_zh: - **修复** 对还没识别过的图片用「粘贴 OCR 文字」（⌘K → G），可能长时间没有任何反应，甚至等到最后也没粘进来。现在识别换成更快的引擎，识别期间会有提示；万一识别慢到你已经切去别的窗口，文字会写进剪贴板，而不是粘到一个看不见的地方
notes_en: - **Fix** "Paste OCR Text" (⌘K → G) on an image that hadn't been recognized yet could sit for minutes with no feedback, and sometimes never paste at all. Recognition now runs on a faster engine and shows progress while it works; if it does take long enough that you've switched away, the text goes to the clipboard instead of into a window you can no longer see

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增 AI 功能**：在设置里填上你自己的模型接口（OpenAI 兼容，DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱、火山方舟、Ollama 都能用），就能在自动化规则里加「AI 改写」动作，用一句话告诉它怎么改，⌘K 或右键一按，文本就地改好。翻译、润色、整理 OCR 结果、改写措辞都行；只处理文本，敏感条目和黑名单来源不会发送。附带两条现成规则：中英互译、文字整理
- **新增** 规则可以设置结果去向：替换当前条目、生成新条目、仅写入剪贴板、直接粘贴到前台
- **优化** 自动化规则编辑器重做为「触发 → 条件 → 动作 → 结果」的流程布局，查看与编辑分开，改动需保存；内置规则可以修改和删除
- **优化** 主窗口、快捷面板和规则列表的右键菜单改为系统原生样式；「文件」菜单新增「打开管理器」
beta.notes_en:
- **New: AI**. Point Settings at your own model endpoint (OpenAI-compatible: DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu, Volcengine Ark, Ollama and more), add an "AI rewrite" action to a rule, tell it what to do in one line, and run it on a text clip from ⌘K or the context menu. Translate, polish, tidy up OCR output, rephrase. Text only; sensitive clips and blocklisted apps are never sent. Two ready-made rules included: Chinese ⇄ English translation and text tidy-up
- **New** Rules can choose where the result goes: replace the clip, create a new clip, clipboard only, or paste into the front app
- **Improve** The rule editor is now a Trigger → Conditions → Actions → Result flow with separate view and edit modes and explicit Save; built-in rules can be edited and deleted
- **Improve** Native context menus in the main window, Quick Panel and rule list; "Open Manager" added to the File menu
